question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
-- Final query: Group by rating of first rented movie, compute averages
WITH first_rental AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id, 
           p.payment_date as earliest_payment,
           p.rental_id
    FROM payment p
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date ASC) = 1
),
customer_ratings AS (
    SELECT fr.customer_id,
           f.rating
    FROM first_rental fr
    JOIN rental r ON fr.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(amount) as total_amount
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_rental_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_rentals
    FROM rental
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    cr.rating,
    AVG(ct.total_amount) as avg_total_amount,
    AVG(crc.total_rentals - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM customer_ratings cr
JOIN customer_totals ct ON cr.customer_id = ct.customer_id
JOIN customer_rental_counts crc ON cr.customer_id = crc.customer_id
GROUP BY cr.rating
ORDER BY cr.rating
